name: io.github.Insightwithhari/rbai-scholar
title: RBAi Scholar
description: Search 24M+ biomedical journal abstracts (20M+ in PubMed) by meaning, exact terms or both at once.

tools.name: search_corpus
tools.description: Semantic search over 24M+ biomedical journal abstracts (more than 20 million of them in PubMed). Finds papers by MEANING, not keywords. Returns papers ranked by a hybrid relevance score (semantic similarity + lexical overlap + citation quality + recency) with abstracts, PMIDs, metadata and DOI links. Supports filters: year range, open access, citations, article type, journal, language, author name, DOI, PMID, and title search.

query.description: The research question or topic to search for. Full abstracts / grant aims are supported (up to 2,000 characters) — e.g. "alpha-synuclein aggregation in Parkinson disease".

topK.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

yearFrom.description: Only papers from this year onwards (optional)

yearTo.description: Only papers up to this year (optional)

type.description: Article type filter (optional). Nearly every paper in the corpus has type "article", so this filter rarely narrows a search. To find reviews, trials or other study types, use studyType.

author.description: Filter by author name, matched as whole words in the order typed, case-insensitive: a surname ("Doudna") or a name as papers print it ("Jennifer A. Doudna"). Semantic search alone cannot find papers by author name; this metadata filter enables it.

doi.description: Exact DOI lookup (e.g. "10.1021/acs.biochem.6c00105"), in any case, with or without https://doi.org/.

pmid.description: PubMed ID lookup (e.g. "42130315"). Uses the btree index — instant.

titleSearch.description: Words of the paper title, matched as whole words in the order typed, case-insensitive. Use when you know part of the paper title.

journal.description: Journal name, matched as whole words in the journal field, case-insensitive ("Nature" also finds Nature Medicine) (optional)

studyType.description: Only papers that PubMed classes as any of these study types (papers with a PubMed ID). "clinical trial" includes randomized controlled trials and "review" includes systematic reviews (optional)

offset.description: Skip this many ranked results to get the next page: 0 (default), then topK, then 2 x topK, with every other argument unchanged. offset + topK at most 200 (optional)

format.description: Leave out for the readable list. "ris" (imports into Zotero, Mendeley and EndNote) or "bibtex" (Zotero, Mendeley, LaTeX): the same papers as a citation file, returned as the result text. "json": the papers as JSON records (optional)

tools.name: search_corpus_keyword
tools.description: KEYWORD/Boolean search over the same 24M+ biomedical abstracts, matching EXACT TERMS rather than meaning. Use this instead of search_corpus when the query contains specific identifiers — gene symbols (TP53, BRCA1), variants (p.Gly12Asp, c.35G>A, rs334), accessions, clinical-trial IDs (NCT…), cell lines, drug codes — or when you want PubMed-style Boolean logic. Vector search loses the exact identity of rare strings, so keyword mode is substantially better for these queries and worse for open natural-language questions. Syntax: terms are ANDed by default; AND / OR / NOT are supported; prefix a term with - to exclude it; use "quoted phrases" for exact adjacent wording. A very broad query is ranked over its best BM25 matches.

query.description: Keyword or Boolean query, e.g. 'TP53 AND apoptosis NOT mouse' or 'BRCA1 "triple negative breast cancer"'. Include at least one distinctive term.

topK.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

yearFrom.description: Only papers from this year onwards (optional)

yearTo.description: Only papers up to this year (optional)

type.description: Article type filter (optional). Nearly every paper in the corpus has type "article", so this filter rarely narrows a search. To find reviews, trials or other study types, use studyType.

author.description: Author name, matched as whole words in the order typed, case-insensitive (optional)

journal.description: Journal name, matched as whole words in the journal field, case-insensitive ("Nature" also finds Nature Medicine) (optional)

doi.description: Exact DOI (e.g. "10.1021/acs.biochem.6c00105"), in any case, with or without https://doi.org/ (optional)

titleSearch.description: Words of the paper title, matched as whole words in the order typed, case-insensitive (optional)

studyType.description: Only papers that PubMed classes as any of these study types (papers with a PubMed ID). "clinical trial" includes randomized controlled trials and "review" includes systematic reviews (optional)

offset.description: Skip this many ranked results to get the next page: 0 (default), then topK, then 2 x topK, with every other argument unchanged. offset + topK at most 200 (optional)

format.description: Leave out for the readable list. "ris" (imports into Zotero, Mendeley and EndNote) or "bibtex" (Zotero, Mendeley, LaTeX): the same papers as a citation file, returned as the result text. "json": the papers as JSON records (optional)

tools.name: get_papers
tools.description: Looks up papers in the RBAi Scholar corpus by PubMed ID or DOI, up to 50 per call. Returns each paper found with its title, authors, year, journal, abstract, DOI, PMID, citation count and open-access status, and lists the identifiers that are not in the corpus.

ids.description: PubMed IDs (e.g. "21376230") or DOIs (e.g. "10.1016/j.cell.2011.02.013", in any case, with or without https://doi.org/), up to 50.

format.description: Leave out for the readable list. "ris" (imports into Zotero, Mendeley and EndNote) or "bibtex" (Zotero, Mendeley, LaTeX): the same papers as a citation file, returned as the result text. "json": the papers as JSON records (optional)

tools.name: find_similar_papers
tools.description: Finds the papers in the RBAi Scholar corpus closest in meaning to one paper already in it, given by PubMed ID or DOI. Compares that paper's stored embedding with the corpus and ranks by similarity plus citation count and recency, leaving the paper itself out. Takes year, open-access, citation, type, study-type, journal, language, author and title filters.

id.description: The paper to start from: its PubMed ID (e.g. "21376230") or DOI (e.g. "10.1016/j.cell.2011.02.013").

topK.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

offset.description: Skip this many ranked results to get the next page: 0 (default), then topK, then 2 x topK, with every other argument unchanged. offset + topK at most 200 (optional)

yearFrom.description: Only papers from this year onwards (optional)

yearTo.description: Only papers up to this year (optional)

type.description: Article type filter (optional). Nearly every paper in the corpus has type "article", so this filter rarely narrows a search. To find reviews, trials or other study types, use studyType.

journal.description: Journal name, matched as whole words in the journal field, case-insensitive ("Nature" also finds Nature Medicine) (optional)

author.description: Author name, matched as whole words in the order typed, case-insensitive (optional)

titleSearch.description: Words of the paper title, matched as whole words in the order typed, case-insensitive (optional)

studyType.description: Only papers that PubMed classes as any of these study types (papers with a PubMed ID). "clinical trial" includes randomized controlled trials and "review" includes systematic reviews (optional)

format.description: Leave out for the readable list. "ris" (imports into Zotero, Mendeley and EndNote) or "bibtex" (Zotero, Mendeley, LaTeX): the same papers as a citation file, returned as the result text. "json": the papers as JSON records (optional)

tools.name: get_references
tools.description: Lists the papers that one paper in the RBAi Scholar corpus cites, given by PubMed ID or DOI, limited to the cited papers that are themselves in the corpus, the most similar to the paper first (by their stored embeddings). Returns each with its title, authors, year, journal, abstract, DOI, PMID, citation count and similarity, and says how many works the paper references in all. Citation links come from OpenAlex.

id.description: The citing paper: its PubMed ID (e.g. "21376230") or DOI (e.g. "10.1016/j.cell.2011.02.013").

topK.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

offset.description: Skip this many papers to get the next page: 0 (default), then topK, then 2 x topK, with every other argument unchanged. offset + topK at most 500 (optional)

format.description: Leave out for the readable list. "ris" (imports into Zotero, Mendeley and EndNote) or "bibtex" (Zotero, Mendeley, LaTeX): the same papers as a citation file, returned as the result text. "json": the papers as JSON records (optional)

tools.name: get_citing_papers
tools.description: Lists the papers in the RBAi Scholar corpus that cite one paper, given by PubMed ID or DOI: the 500 most cited of them, the most similar to the paper first (by their stored embeddings). Returns each with its title, authors, year, journal, abstract, DOI, PMID, citation count and similarity, and says how often the paper is cited in all. Citation links come from OpenAlex.

id.description: The cited paper: its PubMed ID (e.g. "21376230") or DOI (e.g. "10.1016/j.cell.2011.02.013").

topK.description: Number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

offset.description: Skip this many papers to get the next page: 0 (default), then topK, then 2 x topK, with every other argument unchanged. offset + topK at most 500 (optional)

format.description: Leave out for the readable list. "ris" (imports into Zotero, Mendeley and EndNote) or "bibtex" (Zotero, Mendeley, LaTeX): the same papers as a citation file, returned as the result text. "json": the papers as JSON records (optional)
